commit_message:
Fix select button in preview for single-select

This change introduces a MediaSelectionConfirmed event to handle the
final selection step directly from the preview screen in single-select
mode. This fixes a regression where the select button became
non-functional after a previous refactoring which added confirmation
step in single step mode.

The MainActivity now listens for this event to finalize the selection
and finish the activity.
